scope: BE/LE write_i24 with ten selected i32 values; write_int(n,3) with those plus i64 MIN/MAX; lengths0,2,3,5
assertions: Every selected sufficient-buffer case returns and writes low24 bits in selected endian order, preserving suffix; short buffers panic unchanged
